summary.text: Erik Bottcher is a Democratic state senator who represents New York State Senate District 47 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Bottcher served on the New York City Council from 2022 to 2026 and took office in the State Senate on February 4, 2026; he is the Democratic and Working Families Party candidate.

paragraphs.text: Erik Bottcher earned a bachelor's degree from George Washington University.
He represented New York City Council District 3 from 2022 to 2026, succeeding Corey Johnson (D).
He assumed office in the State Senate on February 4, 2026, succeeding Brad Hoylman-Sigal (D).
In the November 3, 2026 general election, Bottcher faces Charlotte Friedman (R).
